preflight.name: ALDE Reliability Preflight
remediation: Keep both repositories on the required branch with clean working trees.
Do not write verification logs into either repository working tree.
Stop only the identified Alpha-Tech server node process before rerunning if Prisma generate lock risk is reported.

classifier.name: ALDE Transcript-Aware Failure Classification Engine
classifier.earlyFailurePolicy: Preflight failures without normal gates are preserved as a synthetic ALDE preflight gate.

assessment.interpretation: A source/executable-contract regression or unclassified failure requires correction or review.
